name: NIS2
fullName: Directive (EU) 2022/2555 on measures for a high common level of cybersecurity across the Union (NIS 2 Directive)
publisher: European Parliament and Council of the European Union
appliesTo: Essential and important entities in sectors listed in Annexes I and II operating in the EU, as transposed into national law.
note: Covers only the entity-level obligations in Articles 20, 21(2) and 23; national transposing laws and implementing acts may add detail not reflected in the mapping.

requirements.title: Management bodies approve and oversee cybersecurity risk-management measures
Management body members follow cybersecurity training
Policies on risk analysis and information system security
Business continuity, backup management, disaster recovery, crisis management
Supply chain security, including direct suppliers and service providers
Secure acquisition, development, maintenance; vulnerability handling and disclosure
Assess effectiveness of cybersecurity risk-management measures
Basic cyber hygiene practices and cybersecurity training
Human resources security, access control and asset management
Notify CSIRT/authority and recipients of significant incidents
Early warning within 24 hours of awareness
Incident notification within 72 hours of awareness
Intermediate report on request of CSIRT or authority
Final report within one month of incident notification
